fullContent:
Raja Mriganka Rasa 
 Reference – Rasendra Sara Sangraha Yakshma Chikitsa. 
 Introduction 
 Raja Mriganka Rasa is an ayurvedic formulation that is known to be prepared from the mixture of minerals and herbs. This formulation is used to treat infections that are mostly related to respiratory system. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Rasasindur (compound of Purified Mercury and Sulphur) – 30 grams 
 Swarna Bhasma (Bhasma of Gold) – 10 grams 
 Rajata Bhasma (Bhasma of Silver) – 10 grams 
 Manashila (Purified and processed Arsenic di-sulphide) – 20 grams 
 Shuddha Gandhaka (Herbal purified Sulphur) – 20 grams 
 Shuddha Haratala (Purified and processed Arsenic tri-sulphide) – 20 grams 
 Varata Bhasma (Cowries) – 10 grams 
 Tankana Bhasma (Borax) – 10 grams 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take first six ingredients and mix well. 
 Fill the mixture in cowries and seal with goat milk. 
 Now heat the mixture in closed container up to 800 – 900 degree Celsius for 5 to 6 hours openly. 
 Now powder the whole mass. 
 
 Dose 
 250 mg, one to two times a day, before or after meals. 
 Indications 
 
 Chronic bronchitis 
 Tuberculosis 
 Phthisis 
 Weakness 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Avoid in pregnancy and lactation 
 Take the medicine under doctor’s prescription 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
